newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week: Cotton: Net Upland sales of 38,300 running bales (RB) were off 29 percent from the previous week and 67 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases for China (14,100 RB), Mexico (10,900 RB), Indonesia (10,100 RB), and Thailand (6,400 RB) were partially offset by reductions for Japan (14,900 RB).

Exports of 140,200 RB--a marketing-year high--exceeded the prior week by 9 percent and the 4-week average by 38 percent. Asian destinations accounted for 74 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 20 percent; East European, 4 percent; African, 1 percent; and West European, 1 percent. American Pima sales of 16,300 RB were mainly for Hong Kong (7,500 RB), Japan (2,600 RB), and Turkey (1,700 RB).
